description: The Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs are imported for TYPES only (audit #7). A value import (`import Anthropic from '@anthropic-ai/sdk'`, `new OpenAI()`) would open a second network path that skips bin/lib/http.ts — no SSRF guard, no egress gate, no retry, no session cost cap, no SESSION.log record. Every completion goes through complete() in bin/lib/anthropic.ts, which sends its requests through http.ts; `import type … from '@anthropic-ai/sdk'` stays allowed.
